annotationStatus: AGENT-JUDGED, PROVISIONAL. Not human judgments. authorRelevant/authorDecoys/authorDoubt come from the agent that wrote each query; judgeRelevant/judgeUncertain from a separate agent instance per domain that judged every query against the whole corpus from title and description only, without seeing the author labels or the query types. Both were blind to the matcher. The human gate is the two-reviewer worksheet.
rubric: partner-real-rubric-v1: a need is served by a project whose described work could plausibly provide what is needed; an offer by a project that could plausibly use what is offered, given what it describes doing. A nearby but different activity is not relevant, and shared vague words are not a reason. Availability, price, distance and language are ignored. Judged from the listed passages only.
